findings.description: The KMS key used to protect audit trail data does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false. Long-lived cryptographic key material without automatic annual rotation increases the impact of key compromise and violates common compliance baselines for audit log encryption.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy (implicit full account access)
findings.description: No explicit key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy granting the entire AWS account root (and thus any IAM principal in the account with kms:* permissions via IAM policy) full control of the key, including kms:Decrypt and kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion. For a key protecting audit trail data this is overly permissive and provides no least-privilege separation between the audit log producers, readers, and key administrators.
